title: Arbayeen Asth Arbayeen Asth Aayi Khuda
body:
Arbayeen Asth Arbayeen Asth Aayi Khuda
Zainab Anda'ad Karbala Asth Aayi Khuda
Bar Sare Qabr E Biradar Chun Raseed
Nala O Aah O Fugaan Az Dil Kasheed
1. As Salam Aye Kushta E Raah E Khuda
As Salam Aye Noor E Chashme Mustafa
As Salam Aye Shah E Bi Ghusl O Kafan
As Salam Aye Khust'ae Az Dil Watan
<<DIVIDER>>
2. As Salam Aye Tashna E Aab E Furaat
As Salam Aye Kashti E Behre Najaat
As Salam Aye Syed O Salar O Maa
As Salam Aye Monis E Gham Khar O Maa
